summary: The core execution chain of the Unicorn Model is well documented: mandatory variables (Time, Manipulation, Stop Hunt → Breaker → Displacement → aligned FVG), an entry trigger, a default stop under the breaker, a fixed 2R target and eight chart examples, all tied together by a solid Pre-Trade Checklist. The weak spots are risk (no risk per trade or sizing rule), bias (Daily Bias is empty), pre-entry invalidation, and an entire empty SMT pillar. Several rules also conflict between notes — timeframe pairings, time windows vs macro/news times, and whether displacement and FVG alignment are truly mandatory.

setups.name: Unicorn entry (Stop Hunt → Breaker → Displacement → aligned FVG)

context.comment: Time and Manipulation are clearly mandatory in Model Variables and Pre-Trade Checklist, but Daily Bias and Intraday Profiles are empty and session times have no timezone.

entry.comment: Where to Enter gives a checkable trigger (close beyond the breaker after displacement), but FVG Touch vs Breaker Touch Entry leaves the entry level to discretion, and FVG Entry Methods adds IOFED/CE/full-fill options without saying if they apply.

stop.comment: Stop Loss Placement sets the default beyond the breaker, with beyond the sweep high/low as the wick-room alternative.

target.comment: Take Profit fixes 2R, with Smooth Edges / EQH-EQL as the reference for extending beyond it.

invalidation.comment: Breaker failure invalidates a live trade (Stop Loss Placement) and the checklist gives no-trade conditions, but nothing says when an unfilled setup is cancelled.

risk.comment: R:R is fixed at 2R, but no risk per trade, daily limit or sizing rule exists; SMT and Position Sizing is a one-line stub.

example.comment: Trade Examples has eight charted examples (NQ, ES, CL), though most don't state stop, exact entry level or result in R.

fixes.title: Define risk per trade and position sizing
fixes.detail: Add a fixed risk per trade (e.g. % of account or fixed $), any daily/weekly loss limit, and how size is derived from stop distance. Write SMT and Position Sizing (currently one line) or drop it from the SMT pillar.

fixes.title: Reconcile the timeframe pairing tables
fixes.detail: Pick one HTF→LTF mapping and make the cheat sheet match it (or explain why both exist), then keep the checklist in sync.

fixes.title: Make the Time rule unambiguous
fixes.detail: State the timezone for all session and macro times, and decide whether macro windows and news-release times outside the session windows satisfy the mandatory Time variable (Example 8 depends on it).

fixes.title: Decide if displacement and FVG alignment are mandatory or graded
fixes.detail: Either keep them mandatory and remove the discretionary escape hatches, or reclassify Scenario 2 breakers and breaker-only trades as a lower grade. Re-label Example 3 accordingly.

fixes.title: Add pre-entry invalidation rules
fixes.detail: Spell out when a pending setup is cancelled before fill (e.g. what happens if price leaves without a retest, closes back through the breaker, or the session window ends). Also say whether FVG Entry Methods and FVG Stop Loss Methods apply to Unicorns or are general FVG background.

fixes.title: Write Daily Bias (or remove it from the model)
fixes.detail: Daily Bias and Intraday Profiles are empty stubs under the HTF Context pillar; define whether a bias is required, optional, or not used.

fixes.title: Standardise the trade examples
fixes.detail: For each example add direction, entry level used (FVG or breaker touch), stop placement, target, result in R, and which mandatory/optional variables were present.

fixes.title: Fill or prune the empty stubs
fixes.detail: The whole SMT pillar is empty (Good vs Bad SMT, Which Assets, Trade Management), as are Session Liquidity, Reversal or Continuation, OHLC vs Swing, HTF and LTF Sweeps, Best Unicorn vs Worst Unicorn and Fractal Setups. Which Assets matters since examples trade NQ, ES and CL; Trade Management should cover break-even/partials if used.

contradictions.description: Timeframe pairings conflict: HTF to LTF Timeframe Alignment (copied into the checklist) maps 1H→5m, 4H→15m and Daily→1H, while the cheat sheet maps 1H→1m, 4H→5m and 4H→1H.

Macro windows fall outside the mandatory session windows: NY AM macro 8:50–9:10 is before the 09:30–12:00 session and the NY PM macro 12:10–13:40 is mostly before the 13:30–16:00 session, yet the checklist treats session windows as mandatory and macros as a bonus inside them.

Time says significant breakers form at session opens AND news drivers, and Example 8 trades a manipulation on the 8:30 news, but the checklist's mandatory Time box only accepts session windows, so Example 8 would fail it.
Model Variables lists displacement as part of the mandatory entry function, but Displacement says a Scenario 2 breaker (little displacement) can still be traded with discretion.

Breaker Block and FVG Aligned and the checklist say no aligned FVG means no Unicorn (mandatory), yet the same note allows trading the breaker alone and Example 3 was taken with a breaker and FVG that were not perfectly aligned.
